title_text: The baby development app recommended by pediatricians
content_text: Kinedu helps new parents support their child’s development from home. You might have a lot of questions about your baby’s development. When will they start crawling? How can I help them sleep? Why do they cry so much? At some point, every new parent turns to their community for answers. Whether that’s other moms, friends, parents, or your pediatrician, having a support system is crucial to getting through these early years. Kinedu is an app designed to add to this support system by giving parents a convenient way to get quick, science-based answers to common – or not so common – parenting questions. Kinedu helps parents with the development of their children aged 0 to 4 years old with video-based playtime activities and articles created by experts on a variety of parenting topics. The app is personalized to the needs of every child and helps parents and babies play together and grow together during the first four years of life. Click HERE to download Kinedu for FREE! How Kinedu works Your baby’s activity plan is personalized by skill, not just age. To make your plan as personalized as possible, fill out a free developmental assessment in the Progress tab of your app. The assessment was developed in partnership with researchers at Stanford University and ensures you get activity and article recommendations specific to your child. - Personalized activity plan according to your baby’s developmental stage. - Explore our library of 2,000+ activities and articles on child development. - You can also search activity and article collections by age and skill. Looking to build specific skills? You can also explore the catalog with all of our activities and articles created by experts with filters for age and skill. Babies form more than 1 million neural connections in the first 1,000 days of life, and the interactions that adults have with them are proven to help them build strong foundations for developing skills. Pediatricians recommend Kinedu because the app provides a simple and practical way for parents to give their child the best start in life through quality interactions. Click HERE to download Kinedu for iPhone or Android! Activities for your baby’s development Feeding, changing diapers, and bathing are a given, but also playing with your child is a key part of these early years. Kinedu gives parents easy activities to do at home with their little ones that use everyday household items. Each activity on the app includes a one to two minute video guide with step-by-step instructions on how to carry out the activity and what to observe as you and your child play. - - - Click HERE to download Kinedu for FREE and watch activity videos! Track your child’s progress In the Progress tab, update your baby’s developmental milestones so that Kinedu can continue personalizing your baby’s activity plan for every age and stage. You can also see what skills are coming up so you know what to look for! - Fill in your baby’s development milestones … - … And follow their progress in all areas! In the Progress section, you can see how your little one is developing in each development area compared to other children their age. This helps you identify any possible delays and see what you can do to support their growth – and remember, every baby develops at their own pace! Ready to find out more about the baby development app recommended by pediatricians and trusted by more than 5 million parents?
